cost_token_rule: Use input usage from the first attempt that reports prompt/input tokens; if no attempt reports them, use prompt characters / 4. Claude prompt tokens include cache creation/read tokens; Sol input includes cached tokens already.

text_metric_rules.sentence_split: Runs of .!? followed by whitespace/end, or blank lines; nonempty lexical segments; abbreviations and decimals are not linguistically resolved.
text_metric_rules.syllables: Lowercase letters only; count [aeiouy]+ groups; subtract one terminal silent e unless consonant+le; minimum one. Words with at least three groups after this adjustment count as polysyllabic; divide by all lexical words.
